description: This file contains the implementation of the FilterGroup controller class within the OpenCart admin catalog namespace. It handles CRUD operations for filter groups, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting filter groups, and manages associated views, request handling, and URL generation.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing filter groups in the OpenCart admin catalog module. Responsible for listing, creating, editing, and deleting filter groups, as well as handling form submissions and generating URLs and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the filter group list view along with header, footer, and navigation components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of filter groups by invoking the getList method and setting the response output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing filter groups, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter group, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the filter group form for creating or updating a filter group, including validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filter groups after permission validation and responds with a JSON success or error message.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON data for AJAX autocomplete functionality by filtering filter groups based on a name query and returning a sorted list of matches.
